unit: T3 / Unit C — the funded demo client that read $0
whatChanged: Press "Load simulated data" now and the demo client shows a real credit file instead of zeros. Before: no bureau, score 0, $0 of funding. After: all three bureaus, score 731, 17.44% utilization, 7 inquiries, $939,500 combined funding, and the file reads as fundable. Three sentences on the underwriting screen that told staff the opposite of what the system does were corrected: an unentered count does NOT make a client look clean, it makes them read "not fundable" and holds their funding back.

src/demo/platform-seed.mjs HAS THE IDENTICAL DEFECT AND IS NOT MINE. Its crsPayload() (lines 12-27) writes consumerSignals.scores.perBureau and crm_payload.scores with no top-level `scores`, and the custom_fields it writes (line 73) carry none of the six underwriting counts. So all 8+ platform demo clients still read $0 and score 0 on UnderwriteIQ. Fixing simulate-client.mjs alone does NOT fix the seeded roster. Needs its own thread — the change is the same shape as mine and my SIM_SCORES / SIM_UNDERWRITING_FIELDS / simTradeline helpers are a working pattern to copy, but the roster varies tier per client (src/demo/roster.mjs) so the six counts must vary with the tier rather than be one hardcoded set.

src/underwrite/engine.mjs:74-80 still carries the same wrong claim I removed from adapter.mjs — 'IT COLLAPSES UNKNOWN TO ZERO ... An unknown reads as a clean file.' That is disproved by src/underwrite/vendor/underwriter.cjs:38-43 and :212. engine.mjs is not in my file list so I left it. My adapter header no longer points at it (pointing a reader at a note that says the opposite is worse than no pointer); it cites the vendored file directly instead. Someone needs to correct engine.mjs note 2.

src/liabilities/index.mjs:65 REF_KEYS omits `accountIdentifier` while src/tradelines/index.mjs:94 includes it, and the comment at src/liabilities/index.mjs:185 claims the two lists match exactly. They do not. This is a LIVE latent bug on the real CRS path, not just the demo one: every real bureau tradeline that identifies itself only as `accountIdentifier` gets accountRefOf() === null, so its billing position can never attach to its card and no card_liabilities row is written. I worked around it inside my own file (each simulated record carries `account_ref` too) rather than editing a file I do not own. THE ONE-LINE FIX another thread must make: add "accountIdentifier" to the end of REF_KEYS at src/liabilities/index.mjs:65. Same story for the balance: src/liabilities/index.mjs:47-49 CURRENT_BALANCE_KEYS omits `currentBalanceAmount`, which src/tradelines/index.mjs:92 accepts.

WHAT I CHOSE FOR THE SIX COUNTS, AND WHY. crs_inquiries_ex 4 / eq 2 / tu 1 — these are not typed in, they are COUNTED from a new SIM_INQUIRIES list of seven real-looking hard inquiries that the payload also plants, so the number on the screen and the inquiries the Inquiry Remover shows can never disagree. crs_negative_items_count 0 and crs_late_payments_count 0 — honest for this file: all four planted accounts now carry paymentStatus 'current' and publicRecords is empty, so a FULL_FUNDING client is not carrying negatives that contradict its own tier. business_age_months 30 — two and a half years, over the engine's 24-month step (src/underwrite/vendor/underwriter.cjs:277-285), which is what a FULL_FUNDING demo needs before any business figure appears at all. These are the same values the grounding pass measured its targets with.

environment is set to "simulated", NOT "sandbox". Stamping sandbox makes triMerge skip the whole row (src/http/client-detail.mjs:76) and the score goes straight back to 0 no matter what else is written. What marks the row as demo is the is_demo column, not a string in the jsonb. There is a test that pins this.

BEHAVIOUR CHANGE WORTH A LOOK: the demo client now displays as fundable with $939,500 of combined funding. That was the target, and every row it touches is flagged is_demo, but it is a screen that now says a person is fundable. Second: the demo client's stamped total_funding_estimate is still 125,000 (from preapprovals.totalCombined, untouched) while UnderwriteIQ now computes 939,500 — two different funding numbers on one demo client. I left it alone as out of scope; it is a one-line change to the payload if you want them to agree.

BEHAVIOUR CHANGE: the seed now writes card_liabilities rows and that write is NOT wrapped in a swallowing catch. If it fails, POST /api/demo/simulate returns 500 instead of quietly producing a half-seeded client. Deliberate — this file's own header criticises exactly that swallowing pattern, and the grounding pass warned against putting required writes inside the existing bare try/catch.

A TRAP IN THE TEST RUNNER, worth adding to CLAUDE.md §12. scripts/run-suite.mjs runs the unit files first and EXITS IMMEDIATELY if the unit phase is non-zero (scripts/run-suite.mjs:74-75). Because main already has 3 unit failures, `npm test` NEVER REACHES THE PG PHASE on this tree. So BASELINE.md's line — "`skipped 0` matters: this run really did exercise the 442 .pg.test.mjs tests" — is wrong. That run never ran a single pg test. I ran the pg phase explicitly, by hand, which is why my numbers are reported in two parts.

ANOTHER TRAP: src/demo/simulate-client.pg.test.mjs poisons the next run of itself. Its test 'a real client's paperwork is never touched' deliberately leaves a NON-demo client with a document behind, and its purge() cannot delete it — the documents archive guard (migrations 150/151/152) only permits a delete when the parent client is_demo. purge() swallows the failure, the org survives, and the next run's before() dies on `duplicate key value violates unique constraint "orgs_slug_key"`, cancelling all seven of its tests. It behaves identically on pristine HEAD, so it is not mine, but it makes the pg phase look broken on any second run. I cleared it in my scratch DB with a one-off script to get clean numbers.

CLAUDE.md §7 assessed and NOT triggered. Nothing here touches dispute logic, fee timing, refunds, payment rails, consent capture or credit-pull type.
